title: Transcript error messages render Windows paths through Markdown, so backslash-escapes vanish (grzeg\.termal shows as grzeg.termal)
outcome:
OBSERVED by Greg 2026-09-11 ~21:15Z: the "Turn failed: failed to read thread ..." message displayed the path as C:\Users\grzeg.termal\codex-home\... although the real file is at C:\Users\grzeg\.termal\codex-home\... (coordinator verified both: the literal folder grzeg.termal does not exist; the real file exists and is 0 bytes). The app-server used the correct path; only the display lost the backslash.
CAUSE (source read, not reproduced in a browser): "Turn failed" is pushed as an assistant text message (src/messages.rs:845) and message-cards.tsx renders assistant text through DeferredMarkdownContent/MarkdownContent, where `\.` is a Markdown escape for a period, so `grzeg\.termal` renders as `grzeg.termal`. Any `\.`, `\_`, `\*`, `\[` inside a Windows path in error text is mangled the same way, which sends the operator looking at the wrong folder.
ASK: render host/system error messages (turn failures, delegation failures) as literal text or inside a code span, or escape backslashes before Markdown rendering; regression with a Windows path containing `\.` and `\_`.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
